title: Active agent capability descriptor
description: Machine-readable manifest of the tools an agent may call against Active (CHECKLIST Step 0.006, PROPOSAL section 4.1 item 6). Versioned with the workspace; consumers must reject unknown major versions.

tools.name: check
tools.description: Parse a file and report errors, cycles, and unresolved names with stable diagnostic codes and spans. Zero exit means clean; --budget-profile selects a named budget preset and --trace emits the same value-free trace as eval.

tools.name: lint
tools.description: Static rules beyond validation: unused lets, depends_on hygiene, complexity, hardcoded-secret heuristics, deprecated usage, partial schema evolution, unknown capabilities, mixed key style, oversized literals, and Data constructs without the mode marker. Text, stable JSON, or SARIF 2.1.0; exits nonzero when any rule fires.

input.disable-lint: optional rule name to disable, repeatable

output.findings: text lines, a JSON array, or a SARIF 2.1.0 log

tools.name: eval
tools.entry: active eval <file> [--format json|yaml|toml] [--path a.b[0]] [--materialise-blobs] [--audit-trail FILE] [--resilient] [--profile NAME] [--trace] [--sandbox strict|data|agent|trusted]
tools.description: Evaluate a file and print a redacted document (JSON, YAML, or TOML per --format). Secrets always render as ***SECRET***; a raw secret in output is a defect, never data. --path emits only the demanded cone, --materialise-blobs includes blob payloads (refused for tainted blobs), and --audit-trail writes a re-validatable redacted audit document.

output.document: redacted document in JSON, YAML, or TOML (per --format)

tools.name: format
tools.description: Format a file in the canonical style without changing its meaning.

tools.name: convert
tools.description: Convert an evaluated result to another format with redaction preserved.

tools.name: graph
tools.entry: active graph [FILE] [--format text|mermaid|dot|json]; active impact|why <KEY> <FILE> [--format text|json]; active graph [FILE] query --query <dependents-of|dependencies-of|shortest-path|secret-tainted-cone|content-addressed-above-size> [--key KEY] [--min-size N] [--format text|json]
tools.description: Query the dependency graph: render it (text/Mermaid/DOT/JSON), list what breaks if a key changes, list what a key is built from, or run a named decisive query. Query results are path lists (or a path pair for shortest-path); values and secrets never appear.

output.graph: text, Mermaid, DOT, or JSON graph per flags
output.query: path lists, a [from, to] path for shortest-path, or {path,size,hash} blob records for content-addressed-above-size

tools.name: generate
tools.description: Emit typed artifacts from an Active schema for the listed codegen targets.

tools.name: schema-introspect
tools.description: List a schema's fields, types, constraints, defaults, descriptions, deprecations, requires targets, and evolution metadata (version, min_reader, min_writer, removed_in, mode) as versioned JSON (INSPECT_VERSION=2).

input.file: path to a .active source file with a schema block

tools.name: explain
tools.description: Deterministic per-diagnostic repair guidance (stable text per code, value-free).

output.guidance: lines of CODE path span: guidance (text), or [{code, path, span, guidance}] with --format json

tools.name: patch
tools.description: Minimal @rename/@patch directives for mechanical diagnostics (safe typos, strict-explicit fills); empty when nothing maps exactly.

output.directives: zero or more @rename/@patch lines (text), or [{kind, path, directive}] with --format json (empty array when nothing maps)

tools.name: capability
tools.description: Print this descriptor; fail closed when the descriptor major does not equal N (handshake). With --check-doc, verify a document's active_capabilities against the advertised tools and fail on refused entries. With --profile, print one sandbox profile.

input.check-doc: optional .active file whose declared capabilities are verified

output.descriptor: this JSON document, the check verdict, or the profile

tools.name: repair
tools.entry: active repair --from <file> [--goal validate|preserve-key|minimize-diff] [--preserve <path>] [--max-steps N] [--format text|json] [--output FILE]
tools.description: Multi-step goal-directed repair: safe @patch/@rename plans applied through the patch engine with stuck (H006) and unrepairable (H008) terminal states.

output.plan: text lines or JSON RepairOutcome; --output writes the repaired source

tools.name: compatibility
tools.description: Compare two schema blocks for compatibility (C040-C044, E040 summary); exits nonzero on breaking changes.

output.report: text lines or JSON finding list
